links.outcome: Agreement of LLM treatment recommendations with tumor board decisions on real cases
links.effect: Overall agreement with MDTB decisions was 52.0% for ChatGPT and 56.9% for Gemini; lower in pulmonary masses without pathological diagnosis and pulmonary metastases.
links.quote: In this single-session evaluation, overall agreement with MDTB decisions was 52.0% for ChatGPT and 56.9% for Gemini.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating LLM (ChatGPT and Gemini) agreement with real-world multidisciplinary tumor board treatment decisions across 102 thoracic oncology cases.
